organization.name: Closira IT Helpdesk
organization.tagline: Employee technology support for everyday IT issues.
organization.support_hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM local time

steps: Confirm the employee is using their company account.
Ask them to use the approved password reset process.
Check whether the account is locked after repeated sign-in attempts.
Escalate if the reset fails, multi-factor authentication cannot be completed, or account compromise is suspected.
Confirm whether the issue affects Wi-Fi, wired network, or both.
Ask the employee to verify airplane mode is off and reconnect to the approved corporate network.
Restart the device once and check whether other sites or services are reachable.
Escalate if multiple employees or locations are affected, or the device cannot obtain a network connection.
Confirm the employee has a working internet connection before connecting to VPN.
Verify the approved VPN client is being used and the employee is signing in with their company account.
Ask for the exact error message and whether multi-factor authentication succeeds.
Escalate if the VPN client fails after a restart, access is denied, or a service outage is suspected.
Collect the device type, operating system, asset tag if available, and exact symptom.
Ask the employee to save work and restart the device when it is safe to do so.
Check cables, power, battery, and connected peripherals for physical issues.
Escalate for a lost or stolen device, signs of malware, physical damage, repeated crashes, or a device that will not power on.
Confirm whether the problem is sending, receiving, signing in, or accessing a shared mailbox.
Check the internet connection and whether the issue occurs in the approved web or desktop mail client.
Ask for any visible error message without requesting passwords or sensitive email content.
Escalate for suspected phishing, account compromise, widespread mail delivery failures, or access to restricted mailboxes.
Confirm the application or resource name and the access needed.
Check whether the software is approved and whether the employee is using a managed device.
Ask for the exact error message and business impact.
Escalate access changes requiring manager or system-owner approval, unapproved software, licensing questions, or admin permissions.

faqs.question: How do I reset my password?
faqs.answer: Use the approved company password reset process. If the reset does not work or your account is locked, contact Human IT Support.

faqs.question: What should I do if Wi-Fi is not working?
faqs.answer: Check that airplane mode is off, reconnect to the approved corporate network, and restart your device once. Report whether other employees are affected.

faqs.question: Why will my VPN not connect?
faqs.answer: Confirm your internet connection works first, then use the approved VPN client and company account. Note the exact error message if it still fails.

faqs.question: How do I request software or access?
faqs.answer: Provide the application or resource name, the access needed, and the business reason. Requests needing approval are routed to Human IT Support.

faqs.question: What should I do about a suspicious email?
faqs.answer: Do not click links or open attachments. Report the message to Human IT Support immediately.

escalation_triggers: Explicit request to speak to Human IT Support
Suspected phishing, malware, account compromise, or unauthorized access
Widespread outage or multiple employees affected
Requests requiring privileged access, licensing decisions, or manager approval
Repeated device failure, physical damage, or inability to power on
